title: Strategic science communication
short: How scientists’ communication choices on social media shape trust and engagement.
text: How can scientists use social media effectively? I test how message strategies, such as sharing personal details, using humor, or presenting themselves in different ways, shape how audiences perceive and engage with scientists. The goal is evidence-based practice that makes science more approachable and transparent.

title: Inclusive participation in science communication
short: Whose voices are heard in online conversations about science.
text: How do diverse voices shape the conversations about science? My work aims to understand what role media plays in highlighting and amplifying voices from underrepresented communities, and whether these platforms can be used to promote inclusive scientific dialogue and reflect diverse perspectives.

title: Navigating new media technologies
short: How new media technologies are changing how scientific information is shared and consumed
text: The digital landscape is rapidly evolving, and new media technologies are revolutionizing how scientific information is shared and consumed. My research explores how new media technologies can be leveraged to improve the dissemination and reception of scientific, health, and environmental information and improve trust in science.
